summary: Hunter reported lost in Elk Park; partner located him back at camp, but a lower leg injury required a carryout — two RCSAR members drove in by UTV the next morning and transported him to the trailhead
notes: RCSAR Far Routt Newsletter Fall Edition Nov-2024; "Injured/Lost Hunter in Elk Park"; sequence lost -> found -> injury carryout; September 2 is the initial call date; UTV evacuation occurred the following morning.
